capabilities.scope: Native Saleor export and separate admin-email workflow; upstream plugins restored, no webhook subscriptions

environment_overrides.CACHES: process-local cache; no external deployment cache required
environment_overrides.CELERY_BROKER_URL: owned Redis instance for the native baseline
environment_overrides.CELERY_TASK_ALWAYS_EAGER: setup-only eager maintenance tasks; disabled during measurement
environment_overrides.DATABASE_URL: owned PostgreSQL cluster; replica alias uses same primary
environment_overrides.EMAIL_URL: owned local SMTP receiver; upstream templates and transport
environment_overrides.STORAGES: local filesystem instead of cloud infrastructure
environment_overrides.worker_concurrency: two processes per backend for the entire workflow

configuration.plugins: upstream defaults; admin email active; no webhook subscriptions
configuration.publication: one task per export; one separately queued email task per export
configuration.retry: upstream export and email tasks do not declare automatic retry
configuration.setup: complete upstream migrations; eager maintenance tasks on empty database outside timing
configuration.timing_boundary: task publication through export, SMTP acceptance, email event and both completed jobs

dataset.generation: Product i, SKU-i, one variant per product
